main_text.p: eorū laudes, tum liberales & ingenuæ artes novi.corporis nova fpecie fui ftudiofis adolefcentiores, præclarifq; doti bus ornatiores & locupletiores factæ: acne qua agreftium procorum protervia timeretur, fuarum queq; fcholarum tanquam liberali cuftodia feptæ & comitatæ:Hæc fecūda problematis archimedei confcientia erit. Teftes igitur ifti logicā & ueritatē & utilitatē tot dierū noctiumq; uigiliis exquifitam teftati de voti noftri cauffa refpondebunt, teque (Lector) utfpero,commonefacient infanam nefcio quā in plerifq; omnibus Europæ academiis altercādi de fuis prę ceptis fophifticam, logicæ & ueritatis & utilitatis longè difsimilē effe, teq; ad ueriora & utiliora præftantifsimç facul tatis ftudia præmiaq; inflammabūt. Ecquid uerò interea turbæ tam graves ob jectæ,theatra fcenicis probris extructa, tribunalia judicum pœnis minacia, dānatio tandem fœdis ignorantiæ calum niæq; notis infamis,è toto philofophiç regno manibus & lingua uelut amputatis inaudita profcriptio, an exiguā voti noftri cauffam perhibebunt? Quid cō-fecuta

page.notes: Page is a single column; the running head "P. RAMI" is printed above the text. Faint marks in the lower left (cursive "cotuta"-like smudge) are show-through, not transcribed. Some letters are uncertain due to scan quality, e.g. "ceptis", "ueriora", "calumniæq" read as printed.
